```{r, warning=F, message=F}


library(dplyr)
library(magrittr)
library(DESeq2)
library(glmnet)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)






# 3.1. Import host counts & metadata


data_dir <- "C:/Users/User/Documents/UCSF/BREATH2.Gene/data"
raw_data_dir <- "C:/Users/User/Documents/UCSF/raw_data"
results_dir <- "C:/Users/User/Documents/UCSF/BREATH2.Gene/results"

# Metadata with folds
metadata_df_with_folds <- read.csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "metadata_df_with_folds.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors=F)

# Host counts (remove gene_symbol column, rownames = ENSG)
host_counts <- read.csv(
  file.path(raw_data_dir, "host_gene_counts.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors=F,
  row.names=1)[, -1]

# Filter to samples used for CV
cv_host_counts <- host_counts[, metadata_df_with_folds$sample_name, drop=F]

# Number of folds
nfolds <- as.numeric(Parameters["Folds", "Count"])

# Map ENSG to SYMBOL
ensg2gene <- read.csv(
  file.path(raw_data_dir, "host_gene_counts.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors=F) %>%
  { `names<-`(.$gene_symbol, .$X) }






# 3.2. LASSO function


lasso_cv_outer_fold <- function(test_fold) {

  set.seed(8634782 + test_fold)

  # Identify train/test samples
  train_idx <- metadata_df_with_folds$fold != test_fold
  test_idx  <- metadata_df_with_folds$fold == test_fold


  
  
  
  
  # 3.2a. VST using training samples only

  
  # Extract training counts
  train_counts <- cv_host_counts[, train_idx, drop=F]

  # Build DESeq2 object using training samples only
  dds_train <- DESeq2::DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
    countData = train_counts,
    colData = metadata_df_with_folds[train_idx, , drop=F],
    design = ~1)

  # Estimate size factors and dispersions from training data
  dds_train <- DESeq2::estimateSizeFactors(dds_train)
  dds_train <- DESeq2::estimateDispersions(dds_train)

  # Apply VST to training samples
  vsd_train <- DESeq2::varianceStabilizingTransformation(
    dds_train,
    blind=F,
    fitType="parametric")

  # Extract VST matrix
  vsd_train_mat <- SummarizedExperiment::assay(vsd_train) %>%
    round(2)

  # Build training X and y
  X_train <- t(as.matrix(vsd_train_mat))
  y_train <- (
    metadata_df_with_folds$LRTI_adjudication[train_idx] == "Definite"
  )

  
  
  
  

  # 3.2b. Fit LASSO lambda path on training data

  
  fit <- glmnet::glmnet(
    X_train,
    y_train,
    family="binomial",
    standardize=TRUE)


  
  
  
  
  # 3.2c. VST using test samples only

  
  # Extract test counts
  test_counts <- cv_host_counts[, test_idx, drop=F]

  dds_test <- DESeq2::DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
    countData = test_counts[rownames(dds_train), , drop=F],
    colData = metadata_df_with_folds[test_idx, , drop=F],
    design = ~1)

  dds_test <- DESeq2::estimateSizeFactors(dds_test)

  # Use dispersion function estimated from training data
  dispersionFunction(dds_test) <- dispersionFunction(dds_train)

  # Apply frozen VST
  vsd_test <- DESeq2::varianceStabilizingTransformation(
    dds_test,
    blind=F,
    fitType="parametric")

  # Extract VST matrix
  vsd_test_mat <- SummarizedExperiment::assay(vsd_test) %>%
    round(2)

  
  
  
  

  # 3.2d. Cross-validated LASSO on training data

  
  cv_fit <- cv.glmnet(
    X_train,
    y_train,
    family="binomial",
    standardize=TRUE,
    nfolds=nfolds)


  
  
  
  
  # 3.2e. Extract lambda.1se coefficients

  
  coefs_lambda <- coef(
    fit,
    s=cv_fit$lambda.1se
  )[-1, 1]

  nonzero_lambda <- coefs_lambda[coefs_lambda != 0]

  lambda_df <- data.frame(
    gene = names(nonzero_lambda),
    coef = as.numeric(nonzero_lambda),
    gene_symbol = ensg2gene[names(nonzero_lambda)],
    fold = test_fold,
    stringsAsFactors=F)

  
  
  
  

  # 3.2f. Extract fixed-n coefficients

  
  extract_fixed_n <- function(target_n) {

    # Number of nonzero coefficients at each lambda
    nz <- apply(
      fit$beta,
      2,
      function(b) sum(b != 0)
    )

    # Find lambda selecting target_n genes
    if (any(nz == target_n)) {

      lambda_target <- fit$lambda[
        which(nz == target_n)[1]
      ]

    } else {

      lambda_target <- fit$lambda[
        which.min(abs(nz - target_n))
      ]
    }

    # Extract coefficients
    coefs_vec <- coef(
      fit,
      s=lambda_target
    )[-1, 1]

    nonzero <- coefs_vec[coefs_vec != 0]

    # Keep top target_n genes if too many are selected
    if (length(nonzero) > target_n) {

      nonzero <- nonzero[
        order(abs(nonzero), decreasing=TRUE)[1:target_n]
      ]
    }

    # Move toward less penalized lambdas if too few genes are selected
    if (length(nonzero) < target_n) {

      lam_idx <- which.min(
        abs(fit$lambda - lambda_target)
      )

      while (
        length(nonzero) < target_n &&
        lam_idx < length(fit$lambda)
      ) {

        lam_idx <- lam_idx + 1

        coefs_vec <- coef(
          fit,
          s=fit$lambda[lam_idx]
        )[-1, 1]

        nonzero <- coefs_vec[coefs_vec != 0]
      }

      # If more than target_n are selected, keep the
      # target_n genes with the largest absolute coefficients
      if (length(nonzero) > target_n) {

        nonzero <- nonzero[
          order(abs(nonzero), decreasing=TRUE)[1:target_n]
        ]
      }
    }

    # Confirm exactly target_n genes were selected
    stopifnot(length(nonzero) == target_n)

    data.frame(
      gene = names(nonzero),
      coef = as.numeric(nonzero),
      gene_symbol = ensg2gene[names(nonzero)],
      fold = test_fold,
      stringsAsFactors=F)
  }


  # Extract n=3 and n=1 coefficients
  n3_df <- extract_fixed_n(target_n=3)
  n1_df <- extract_fixed_n(target_n=1)


  # Return fold-specific results
  list(
    lambda = lambda_df,
    n3 = n3_df,
    n1 = n1_df,
    vsd_cols = vsd_test_mat
  )
}






# 3.3. Run LASSO across folds


lasso_results <- lapply(
  1:max(metadata_df_with_folds$fold),
  lasso_cv_outer_fold)


# Collect frozen VST matrices
vsd_list <- lapply(
  lasso_results,
  `[[`,
  "vsd_cols")

full_vsd <- do.call(
  cbind,
  vsd_list)


# Ensure columns are in the same order as metadata
full_vsd <- full_vsd[
  ,
  metadata_df_with_folds$sample_name,
  drop=F]


# Safety checks for VST matrix
stopifnot(
  !any(duplicated(colnames(full_vsd))),
  all(colnames(full_vsd) == metadata_df_with_folds$sample_name)
)


# Save full VST matrix
write.csv(
  full_vsd,
  file.path(data_dir, "vst_full.csv"),
  row.names=T)


# Collect fold-specific LASSO coefficients
lasso_fold_coefs <- lasso_results %>%
  lapply(function(x) x$lambda) %>%
  bind_rows()

lasso_fold_coefs_n3 <- lasso_results %>%
  lapply(function(x) x$n3) %>%
  bind_rows()

lasso_fold_coefs_n1 <- lasso_results %>%
  lapply(function(x) x$n1) %>%
  bind_rows()


# Save LASSO coefficients
write.csv(
  lasso_fold_coefs,
  file.path(results_dir, "lasso_fold_coefs.csv"),
  row.names=F)

write.csv(
  lasso_fold_coefs_n3,
  file.path(results_dir, "lasso_fold_coefs_n3.csv"),
  row.names=F)

write.csv(
  lasso_fold_coefs_n1,
  file.path(results_dir, "lasso_fold_coefs_n1.csv"),
  row.names=F)






# 3.4. Safety Checks


# Number of selected genes per fold
print(table(lasso_fold_coefs$fold))

print(table(lasso_fold_coefs_n3$fold))

print(table(lasso_fold_coefs_n1$fold))


# Confirm exactly 3 genes per fold
stopifnot(
  all(table(lasso_fold_coefs_n3$fold) == 3)
)


# Confirm exactly 1 gene per fold
stopifnot(
  all(table(lasso_fold_coefs_n1$fold) == 1)
)


# Confirm all selected genes have valid symbols
stopifnot(
  all(!is.na(lasso_fold_coefs$gene_symbol)),
  all(!is.na(lasso_fold_coefs_n3$gene_symbol)),
  all(!is.na(lasso_fold_coefs_n1$gene_symbol))
)


# Confirm VST sample ordering
stopifnot(
  all(colnames(full_vsd) == metadata_df_with_folds$sample_name)
)






```
